nodes.label: settings.json
nodes.description: Claude CLI permissions configuration with extensive allowlist for test commands, git operations, Python REPL, pytest, and various jarvis-specific commands. Includes /tmp as additional working directory.

nodes.label: settings.local.json
nodes.description: Local development permissions for testing voice dependencies, checking CSM availability, running pytest, managing processes, and accessing user home directories and HF cache.

nodes.label: jarvis-full-revision.md
nodes.description: Comprehensive implementation plan for rewriting Jarvis from flat vLLM/Qwen voice loop into proactive personal AI with LangGraph orchestration, mem0 memory, Claude API brain, Google Calendar/Gmail integration, Kokoro TTS, and background monitors.

nodes.label: jarvis-full-revision-design.md
nodes.description: Design specification for Jarvis full revision. Describes architecture with reactive and proactive modes, LangGraph agent graph, mem0 memory layers (episodic/semantic/graph), tool registry, voice pipeline changes, and Google integration.

nodes.label: VOXTRAL_IMPLEMENTATION.md
nodes.description: Documentation for hybrid approach using Voxtral-Mini-4B-Realtime for STT (speech-to-text) with <500ms latency and CSM/Kokoro for TTS. Explains that Voxtral is STT-only, not a unified speech model.

nodes.label: VOXTRAL_MIGRATION.md
nodes.description: Migration guide for transitioning from separate faster-whisper STT and CSM/Kokoro TTS to unified Voxtral-Mini-4B-Realtime model. Documents configuration changes, dependency updates, and rollback procedures.
